39925-a-short-history-of-english-music.title: English Music
39925-a-short-history-of-english-music.creator: Ernest Ford
39925-a-short-history-of-english-music.description: A book by Ernest Ford. England at one time musical and "merrie"--England before the Reformation--Out-door life--Natural dramatic instincts--Isolation of country districts in early days--Performances of itinerant minstrels--Ban of the Church--Gradual improvement--Effect of the wars of the Roses--Early perfection of sacred music--Difficult times after repudiation of Rome by Henry VIII.--His policy and that of Queen Elizabeth--Edward VI.

arxiv-1901-00064.title: Impossibility and Uncertainty Theorems in AI Value Alignment or why your AGI should not have a utility function Thanks: The views expressed in this paper are those of the author alone, and should not be taken as positions of the Partnership on AI, its members, or the Electronic Frontier Foundation.
arxiv-1901-00064.creator: Peter Eckersley
arxiv-1901-00064.description: Abstract Utility functions or their equivalents (value functions, objective functions, loss functions, reward functions, preference orderings) are a central tool in most current machine learning systems. These mechanisms for defining goals and guiding optimization run into practical and conceptual difficulty when there are independent, multi-dimensional objectives that need to be pursued simultaneously and cannot be reduced to each other.

arxiv-2206-00050.title: FiLM-Ensemble: Probabilistic Deep Learning via Feature-wise Linear Modulation
arxiv-2206-00050.creator: Mehmet Ozgur Turkoglu, Alexander Becker, Hüseyin Anil Gündüz, Mina Rezaei, Bernd Bischl, Rodrigo Caye Daudt, Stefano D’Aronco, Jan Dirk Wegner, Konrad Schindler
arxiv-2206-00050.description: Abstract The ability to estimate epistemic uncertainty is often crucial when deploying machine learning in the real world, but modern methods often produce overconfident, uncalibrated uncertainty predictions. A common approach to quantify epistemic uncertainty, usable across a wide class of prediction models, is to train a model ensemble .

arxiv-2305-07714.title: The Perron solution for elliptic equations
arxiv-2305-07714.creator: without the maximum principle
arxiv-2305-07714.description: Abstract Abstract In this article we consider the Dirichlet problem on a bounded domain \Omega\subset\mathds{R}^{d} with respect to a second-order elliptic differential operator in divergence form. We do not assume a divergence condition as in the pioneering work by Stampacchia, but merely assume that 0 is not a Dirichlet eigenvalue.

arxiv-2307-07532.title: Fits to measurements of rare heavy flavour decays
arxiv-2307-07532.creator: Ben Allanach
arxiv-2307-07532.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ben Allanach. This write-up is intended to form part of the proceedings for Lepton-Photon 2023. We review the decays b → c ​ ℓ ​ ν ¯ ℓ b\rightarrow c\ell\bar{\nu}_{\ell} (where ℓ ∈ { e , μ , τ } \ell\in\{e,\mu,\tau\} ) as well as b → s ​ μ + ​ μ − b\rightarrow s\mu^{+}\mu^{-} and b → s ​ e + ​ e − b\rightarrow se^{+}e^{-} , giving the current state-of-the-art in terms of measurements.

arxiv-2308-13879.title: The DiffuseStyleGesture+ entry to the GENEA Challenge 2023
arxiv-2308-13879.creator: Sicheng Yang, Haiwei Xue, Zhiyong Wu, Minglei Li, Zonghong Dai, Zhensong Zhang, Songcen Xu, Xiaofei Wu
arxiv-2308-13879.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce the DiffuseStyleGesture+, our solution for the Generation and Evaluation of Non-verbal Behavior for Embodied Agents (GENEA) Challenge 2023, which aims to foster the development of realistic, automated systems for generating conversational gestures. Participants are provided with a pre-processed dataset and their systems are evaluated through crowdsourced scoring.

arxiv-2309-06432.title: Can the Parker Solar Probe Detect a CME-flare Current Sheet?
arxiv-2309-06432.creator: Yuhao Chen, Zhong Liu, Pengfei Chen, David F. Webb, Qi Hao, Jialiang Hu, Guanchong Cheng, Zhixing Mei, Jing Ye, Qian Wang, Jun Lin
arxiv-2309-06432.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yuhao Chen, Zhong Liu, Pengfei Chen, David F. Webb, Qi Hao, Jialiang Hu, Guanchong Cheng, Zhixing Mei, Jing Ye, Qian Wang, Jun Lin. A current sheet (CS) is the central structure in the disrupting magnetic configuration during solar eruptions.

arxiv-2311-03601.title: A binary invariant of matrix mutation
arxiv-2311-03601.creator: Roger Casals
arxiv-2311-03601.description: Abstract . We construct a binary mutation invariant for skew-symmetric integer matrices. The invariant is not an integer congruence invariant for matrices of odd size: we provide examples of congruent such matrices with different values for the invariant. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 13F60. Secondary: 15A15. 1.

arxiv-2502-19587.title: NeoBERT: A Next-Generation BERT
arxiv-2502-19587.creator: Lola Le Breton, Quentin Fournier, Mariam El Mezouar, Sarath Chandar
arxiv-2502-19587.description: Abstract Recent innovations in architecture, pre-training, and fine-tuning have led to the remarkable in-context learning and reasoning abilities of large auto-regressive language models such as LLaMA and DeepSeek. In contrast, encoders like BERT and RoBERTa have not seen the same level of progress despite being foundational for many downstream NLP applications.

arxiv-2504-00631.title: Dipolar-exchange spin waves in thin bilayers
arxiv-2504-00631.creator: Rob den Teuling 1, Ritesh Das 1, Artem V. Bondarenko 1,2, Elena V. Tartakovskaya 1,2,3, Gerrit E. W. Bauer 4,5, Yaroslav M. Blanter 1
arxiv-2504-00631.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rob den Teuling 1, Ritesh Das 1, Artem V. Bondarenko 1,2, Elena V. Tartakovskaya 1,2,3, Gerrit E. W. Bauer 4,5, Yaroslav M. Blanter 1. We investigate the dipolar-exchange spin wave spectrum in thin ferromagnetic bilayers with in-plane magnetization, incorporating interlayer exchange coupling and intra- and interlayer dipolar interactions.

arxiv-2506-05568.title: Ravan : Multi-Head Low-Rank Adaptation for Federated Fine-Tuning
arxiv-2506-05568.creator: Arian Raje 1 Baris Askin 1 Divyansh Jhunjhunwala 1 Gauri Joshi 1 1 Carnegie Mellon University
arxiv-2506-05568.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Arian Raje 1 Baris Askin 1 Divyansh Jhunjhunwala 1 Gauri Joshi 1 1 Carnegie Mellon University. Large language models (LLMs) have not yet effectively leveraged the vast amounts of edge-device data, and federated learning (FL) offers a promising paradigm to collaboratively fine-tune LLMs without transferring private edge data to the cloud. To operate within the computation and communication constraints of edge devices, recent literature on federated fine-tuning of LLMs proposes the use of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and similar parameter-efficient methods.

arxiv-2507-22540.title: Radial solutions of truncated Laplacian equations in punctured balls
arxiv-2507-22540.creator: Isabeau Birindelli, Françoise Demengel, Fabiana Leoni
arxiv-2507-22540.description: Abstract We consider equations involving the truncated laplacians 𝒫 k ± {\cal P}_{k}^{\pm} and having lower order terms with singular potentials posed in punctured balls. We study both the principal eigenvalue problem and the problem of classification of solutions, in dependence of their asymptotic behavior near the origin, for equations having also superlinear absorbing lower order terms.

arxiv-2509-08829.title: PerFairX: Is There a Balance Between Fairness and Personality in Large Language Model Recommendations?
arxiv-2509-08829.creator: Chandan Kumar Sah
arxiv-2509-08829.description: Abstract The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into recommender systems has enabled zero-shot, personality-based personalization through prompt-based interactions, offering a new paradigm for user-centric recommendations. However, incorporating user personality traits via the OCEAN model highlights a critical tension between achieving psychological alignment and ensuring demographic fairness.

europmc-pmc7573621.title: Common and distinct patterns of intrinsic brain activity alterations in major depression and bipolar disorder: voxel-based meta-analysis.
europmc-pmc7573621.creator: Gong J, Wang J, Qiu S, Chen P, Luo Z, Wang J, Huang L, Wang Y.
europmc-pmc7573621.description: Identification of intrinsic brain activity differences and similarities between major depression (MDD) and bipolar disorder (BD) is necessary. However, results have not yet yielded consistent conclusions. A meta-analysis of whole-brain resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI)...

pmc-10747861.title: Manifestation of Health Denialism in Attitudes toward COVID-19 Vaccination: A Qualitative Study
pmc-10747861.creator: Iwona Młoźniak, Urszula Zwierczyk, Elżbieta Rzepecka, Mateusz Kobryn, Marta Wilk, Mariusz Duplaga, Sheikh Mohammad Fazle Akbar
pmc-10747861.description: Science denialism is characterized by the refusal to accept existing consensus and available evidence. Typical strategies denialists employ include spreading conspiracies, selective use of information, relying on fake experts, or general fallacies in logic. A flood of misinformation, fake news, and conspiracy theories accompanied the COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-11319067.title: White Matter Microstructural Changes Using Ultra-Strong Diffusion Gradient MRI in Adult-Onset Idiopathic Focal Cervical Dystonia
pmc-11319067.creator: Claire L. MacIver, Derek Jones, Katy Green, Konrad Szewczyk-Krolikowski, Andre Doring, Chantal M.W. Tax, Kathryn J. Peall
pmc-11319067.description: Background and ObjectivesAdult-onset idiopathic focal cervical dystonia (AOIFCD) involves abnormal posturing of the cervical musculature and, in some individuals, an associated head tremor. Existing neuroimaging studies have implicated key motor networks. However, measures used to date lack specificity toward underlying pathophysiologic differences.

pmc-11344326.title: Prevalence of classic and non-classic pain sites of coronary artery disease: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11344326.creator: Mayar Abdullatef, Maya Omran, Anas Bitar, Bayan Alsaid
pmc-11344326.description: Study objectiveThis study aims to assess the prevalence of both classic and non-classic pain sites in patients with ischemic heart disease, emphasizing the importance of recognizing and not disregarding non-classic symptoms.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 100 patients diagnosed with coronary artery disease (CAD) who were admitted to two major hospitals in Syria.

pmc-11575063.title: The predictive value of nomogram for adnexal cystic-solid masses based on O-RADS US, clinical and laboratory indicators
pmc-11575063.creator: Chunchun Jin, Meifang Deng, Yanling Bei, Chan Zhang, Shiya Wang, Shun Yang, Lvhuan Qiu, Xiuyan Liu, Qiuxiang Chen
pmc-11575063.description: BackgroundOvarian cancer remains a leading cause of death among women, largely due to its asymptomatic early stages and high mortality when diagnosed late. Early detection significantly improves survival rates, and the Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System Ultrasound (O-RADS US) is currently the most commonly used method, but has limitations in specificity and accuracy.

pmc-11580647.title: Fostering holistic eye care for children with special educational needs: an interprofessional education program bridging optometry and education
pmc-11580647.creator: Kin Wan, Kin Hei Lau, Ho Yin Wong, Wing Yan Yu, Allen Ming Yan Cheong, Eva Yin-Han Chung, Chun Wai Lum, Kuen Fung Sin, Tsz-Wing Leung
pmc-11580647.description: PurposeThis study outlines the initiation of an interprofessional education (IPE) program designed for optometry and education students. The program aimed to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and improve the management of eye health in children with special educational needs (SEN) – a vulnerable and underserved group.

pmc-11590295.title: Suitability of large language models for extraction of high-quality chemical reaction dataset from patent literature
pmc-11590295.creator: Sarveswara Rao Vangala, Sowmya Ramaswamy Krishnan, Navneet Bung, Dhandapani Nandagopal, Gomathi Ramasamy, Satyam Kumar, Sridharan Sankaran, Rajgopal Srinivasan, Arijit Roy
pmc-11590295.description: With the advent of artificial intelligence (AI), it is now possible to design diverse and novel molecules from previously unexplored chemical space. However, a challenge for chemists is the synthesis of such molecules. Recently, there have been attempts to develop AI models for retrosynthesis prediction, which rely on the availability of a high-quality training dataset.

pmc-12730058.title: CFD Application to Poultry Crate Design Improving Internal Airflow Velocities
pmc-12730058.creator: Victor Abreu de Lima, Jasson Fernandez Gurgel, Daniel Gurgel Pinheiro, Nítalo André Farias Machado, José Antonio Delfino Barbosa Filho, Antonio Velarde, Iran José Oliveira da Silva, Marcos Vinícius da Silva, Danilo Florentino Pereira
pmc-12730058.description: Simple SummaryPoultry transport over long distances is a common practice and involves billions of birds each year. However, many birds suffer stress during travel, especially when the weather is hot and there is not enough fresh air inside the transport crates.

pmc-13251699.title: Correlation between early cumulative fluid balance and 90-day all-cause mortality in patients with acute pancreatitis: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13251699.creator: Jianlei Chen, Jinyuan Chi, Hao Li
pmc-13251699.description: Highlights•Positive day-7 fluid balance linked to higher 90-day mortality in acute pancreatitis ICU patients.•Nonlinear U-shaped relation: both high positive and negative balances increase risk.•Biphasic fluid strategy suggested: early resuscitation, then goal-directed de-escalation.•First large-scale MIMIC-IV study quantifying 7-day fluid balance impact on AP survival.

pmc-13400228.title: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase variants modify 3D genomic organization to suppress maladaptive gene expression and vascular disease
pmc-13400228.creator: Christina Signoretti, Shun Matsumura, Melinee D’silva, Comfort Williams, Brenden Marshall, Samuel Fatehi, Rhonda Drewes, Abby L Grier, Monika Dzieciatkowska, Angelo D’Alessandro, Yongho Bae, Sachin A Gupte
pmc-13400228.description: The 3D genome architecture is a higher-order organization of chromosomes within the nucleus that is critical to the control of epigenomic modifications. However, our knowledge regarding the role of 3D genomic organization in the regulation of vascular gene expression and function is lacking.

pmc-13440178.title: Temporal single-cell atlas of full-length Huntington’s disease mouse model defines stage-specific signatures of corticostriatal dysfunction
pmc-13440178.creator: Ashley B Robbins, Paul T Ranum, Icnelia Huerta-Ocampo, Michael Kuckyr, Beverly L Davidson
pmc-13440178.description: BackgroundHuntington’s disease (HD) involves progressive corticostriatal dysfunction, yet the temporal dynamics and cell type-specific vulnerability patterns remain incompletely understood. While recent single-cell studies in rapidly progressing models have revealed early developmental and regional changes, temporal profiling distinguishing pathogenic mechanisms from normal aging in full-length HTT models remains lacking.

pmc-13619343.title: First Record of Triplet Embryos in Sea Turtles: Evidence of Natural Polyembryony in a Wild Green Turtle (Chelonia mydas) Nest From Guanahacabibes, Cuba
pmc-13619343.creator: Julia Azanza‐Ricardo, Annelisse Bárcenas‐Ibarra, Kevin Armando Domínguez‐León, Randy Calderón‐Peña, Yunaisy Guerrero‐Esquijarosa, Eduardo E. Colin‐Hidalgo, José A. Marmolejo‐Valencia, Horacio Merchant‐Larios, Daniel J. Sánchez‐Ochoa, Horacio de la Cueva
